items.title: AEO and GEO Aren't Just SEO Rebrands: Build Content Ecosystems for AI Discovery
items.summary: Ross Simmonds shares insights from an iPullRank interview emphasizing that AEO and GEO require evaluating consensus across Reddit, YouTube, PR, and more, not just site optimization. Traditional SEO mindsets will lose budget and relevance. Focus on synthetic queries and AI retrieval systems.

items.title: Google Sacrifices Organic Traffic to Battle AI Rivals: Shift Visibility Strategy
items.summary: Neil Patel explains Google's AI Overviews as a strategic move to retain users against standalone AI tools, even at the cost of some traffic. Content marketers must pivot from chasing clicks to broader visibility metrics. This data reshapes SEO and digital marketing approaches.

items.title: Google Tests AI-Generated Headlines in Search Results After Discover
items.summary: Google is experimenting with AI-written headlines in traditional Search, mirroring its prior Discover tests that became permanent. This raises concerns for publishers over control of titles, tone, and click-through rates. SEO pros must monitor impacts on SERP performance.

items.title: SEO 2.0: Content Marketing's Role in AI Search Visibility
items.summary: The evolution of SEO now hinges on content being cited by AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot. Brands must optimize for AI discovery beyond traditional rankings. Content marketing strategies are adapting to this new reality.

items.title: 5 GEO Strategies to Boost Brand Recommendations in AI Search
items.summary: Key tactics include measuring AI visibility, maintaining SEO foundations, and leveraging structured data for AI recommendation. Don't abandon traditional SEO as it feeds AI engines. These steps prepare brands for 2026 AI dominance.

items.title: Horror Novel 'Shy Girl' Canceled Over Suspected A.I. Use
items.summary: Hachette Book Group canceled the upcoming release of Mia Ballard's horror novel 'Shy Girl' after an AI detection tool flagged much of the content as AI-generated. The publisher requires authors to confirm their work is original and has drawn a firm line against AI-generated text. The incident has ignited debates on AI detection accuracy and its role in publishing.

items.title: Guardian Exposes AI-Powered Publishing Scams
items.summary: A Guardian investigation uncovers AI-powered scams targeting authors in the publishing space. Services like Grammarly are facing lawsuits over features accused of misleading users. The report highlights vulnerabilities in self-publishing amid rising AI adoption.

items.title: The Woke Agenda Is Pushing Traditional Families Out of Children's Books
items.summary: An author shares how their wholesome children's book promoting science, family, and healthy values was rejected by the publishing industry. The story points to biases against traditional narratives in children's literature. Discussion covers impacts on storytelling for young readers.

items.title: Berkley Scores YA Author Karen M. McManus’s Adult Debuts in Massive Two-Book Deal
items.summary: Publishers Weekly announces Berkley acquiring two adult debut novels from bestselling YA author Karen M. McManus. Montlake secures Sara Field’s lupine romances among other deals. The weekly roundup features significant publishing contracts.

items.title: 'The Deal' by Elle Kennedy Gets New Cover and Paperback Pre-Order Launch
items.summary: The Deal, first book in Elle Kennedy's Off Campus series, receives a new cover design with paperback now available for pre-order. Audiobook art updated accordingly. Fans show strong enthusiasm for the popular romance title.

items.title: Woke Gatekeepers Attempt to Ban Conservative Novel 'Life in Woke America'
items.summary: Author Joel Rakow describes efforts by woke gatekeepers and censorship groups to prevent publication of his novel through threats and blacklisting. He outlines the challenges in an article linked in the post. The story raises questions about conservative voices in publishing.

items.title: Kelly Marie Tran Reflects on 'The Last Jedi' Backlash
items.summary: Kelly Marie Tran reflects on the backlash she faced nearly 10 years ago for her role in Star Wars: The Last Jedi, explaining that she initially internalized the hate as proof she did not belong in the industry. After years of therapy and support groups, she now understands it was not her fault and would handle it differently today. The post highlights ongoing discussions about fan reactions to Star Wars casting and story choices.

items.title: Paapa Essiedu Addresses Racist Backlash to Harry Potter Snape Casting
items.summary: Paapa Essiedu, cast as Severus Snape in the Harry Potter TV reboot, responds to racist backlash by stating 'The abuse fuels me.' The casting choice has ignited controversy among fans upset with the change from the books' description. The IGN post links to an article detailing the actor's defiant stance.

items.title: Viral Backlash to Brad Pitt's Alleged 'Woke Anti-Ice' Hollywood Moment
items.summary: Juanita Broaddrick shares a video criticizing Hollywood's 'woke Anti-Ice Bullshit' involving Brad Pitt, expressing strong disdain for the industry's direction. The post receives over 14,000 likes and thousands of engagements, amplifying audience frustration with perceived preachy content. It underscores ongoing viewer pushback against Hollywood productions.

items.title: William Shatner Laments Starfleet Academy Cancellation Amid 'Woke' Backlash
items.summary: William Shatner expresses disappointment over the cancellation of Star Trek: Starfleet Academy after its second season, despite an 87% Rotten Tomatoes rating. He mocks critics celebrating the move due to the show's diverse casting and first openly gay Klingon, comparing it to original Star Trek's interracial kiss that would now be deemed 'woke.' Shatner notes Star Trek: The Next Generation also endured initial fan backlash.

items.title: Hollywood Shifts as Woke Films Continue to Flop at March 2026 Box Office
items.summary: Woke films are bombing at the box office while family-friendly fare surges, prompting Hollywood to recalibrate amid parent-driven demand. March 2026 marks a historic recovery with strong performances from non-woke hits like those featuring Ghostface. Studios appear to be responding to audience preferences for less preachy content.

items.title: Project Hail Mary Achieves Record $81M U.S. Opening Weekend
items.summary: Ryan Gosling's Project Hail Mary opens to $81 million domestically and $141 million globally, becoming Amazon MGM's largest box-office debut ever. The sci-fi adaptation outperforms projections in a strong March 2026 weekend. The success highlights robust audience turnout for major tentpole releases.

items.title: Zordi Uses Google AI to Scale Greenhouse Farming for Small Agribusinesses
items.summary: Zordi, an agricultural platform, combines AI-powered robotics and machine learning with Google's Gemini and NotebookLM to optimize greenhouse farming operations. This integration helps small businesses scale smarter by improving efficiency in strawberry production and beyond. It's a prime example of practical AI tools transforming small-scale agriculture.

items.title: tZERO Launches Halo: Secure AI Integration for Digital Asset Wallets
items.summary: tZERO has introduced Halo, a new tool enabling AI to connect directly to digital asset wallets with customizable guardrails on transaction size, frequency, assets, and destinations. This facilitates safe AI-driven automation in finance, crucial for businesses entering the machine-to-machine economy. Closed beta is now available, marking a significant product move in tokenized assets.

items.title: Claude and ChatGPT Power New Tax Prep Tools for Small Businesses
items.summary: Startups and tax pros are deploying AI models like Claude and ChatGPT for tax preparation services targeted at small businesses. These tools streamline complex filings but require caution due to accuracy risks. This development highlights emerging, workable AI applications in small business finance.

items.title: Businesses Adopt 'Director of AI Productivity' Over Chief AI Officers
items.summary: Enterprises are shifting from Chief AI Officers to 'Directors of AI Productivity' to better integrate AI into operations, with lessons applicable to small businesses. Practical advice includes real-world uses like enhancing workflows without massive overhauls. This reflects a meaningful pivot in AI platform strategies for productivity gains.
